item.title: The eBPF Program Model
item.description: How an eBPF program enters the kernel as bytecode, passes the verifier and JIT compilation, and attaches to a hook; how it talks to the kernel and user space through maps, helpers, and kfuncs; and a hands-on look with bpftrace at syscall counts, a latency histogram, and a verifier rejection.
